description: A zone that a resolver of ipv6ddns answers, to the clients of its network, from memory: see the [resolver](../resolver.md). Its debounce defaults to none, as nothing is sent anywhere.

resolver.description: The resolver that answers the zone, of resolvers. Needed only with more than one.

records.description: Records of names of the zone that no task publishes, one per entry, in the syntax of a zone file, relative to the zone or absolute within it: printer A 192.168.1.20, files CNAME nas, _ipp._tcp SRV 0 0 631 printer. A record without a TTL has the zone's.

ttl.description: The TTL of the names' addresses, and of the records that give none: 5m, 1h. Default: 1m.
